name: zimbench
author: NucleoOS
description: F0 measurements for the ZIM reader (docs/ZIM_READER_PLAN.md): SD random reads, zstd cluster decode, dirent and title lookups, HTTP Range throughput. Not a store app.
usage: zimbench seek FILE [N] [SIZE] | write FILE MB | read FILE [MB] | zstd ZIM [N] | lookup ZIM [N] | title ZIM PREFIX... | get ZIM PATH... | http URL [CHUNKS] [KB]
